defective_pattern: Overwriting or mutating raw input datasets on disk during cleaning, imputation, or scoring.
why_defective: Destroys raw data integrity, prevents forensic verification, and violates Directive 19 immutability standards.
observed_symptoms: Modification timestamp of raw input dataset changes during pipeline execution
Raw data and cleaned data share the same file path
corrective_remedy: Preserve raw data permanently as read-only inputs; export transformed datasets to new timestamped output files (e.g. data_cleaned.xlsx).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Target output path in data cleaning or transformation is identical to raw input path.
